title: DerivativeRegister
description:
POST /derivatives/register — the on-device AI contribute-back (OL-1). A consumer that computed expensive, identity-bearing AI on-device (Apple FeaturePrint/Vision embeddings, faces, OCR, Speech transcripts, auto-tags, aesthetics — the LoupeJSON `ai` block) FIRST writes the blob through the mount to <nas_root>/.juicemount/derivatives/<inode>/ai.loupe.json (it has write access), THEN calls this to make the server index it so every other client + the web UI reuses it. SUPERSEDED by REGISTER-ROUTE (2026-08-04): this route is no longer AI-only. A consumer may commit `ai`, `proxy`, `thumbnail` and `waveform` blobs it generated on-device. `tech` remains server-only (it is ffprobe output, not an artifact), and `filmstrip` is withheld until its reader contract is specified. Requires the `contribute-derivatives` capability token. The server is the source-hash authority: the consumer cannot compute the contract xxh3 (it uses xxh64), so it VOUCHES with source_size+source_mtime (the live stat it computed the AI against); the server re-stats and accepts ONLY on a size+mtime match (else 409 — the AI was computed against stale bytes), then stamps the canonical xxh3 itself.

REQUEST body (application/json): { inode:int, kind:"ai"|"proxy"|"thumbnail"|"waveform", producer:"on-device"|"macos-node", model:string, dim:int, source_size:int, source_mtime:int, blob_rel_path:string }. REGISTER-ROUTE (2026-08-04): blob_rel_path MUST equal the reserved filename for the kind (WRITE_PLACEMENT §2) or the request is rejected 400 — the consumer does not choose a path inside the provider namespace; for kind==ai it may be omitted and is resolved to whichever of ai.logger.json / ai.loupe.json is on disk. The blob MUST already exist: the server stats it and returns 409 if absent, so a row is never minted for a blob that is not there (WRITE_PLACEMENT §4 — the row is the commit point). The size/mtime vouch and the server-side re-stat apply to every kind, not just ai.

This document is the 200 RESPONSE.

inode.description: Echo of the registered asset's JuiceFS inode.

registered.description: true on a successful register (200). A stale-bytes register returns HTTP 409 with no body validated here.

derivative.description: The manifest row the server wrote — identical shape to a derivatives.schema.json entry. The server stamped source_hash (its own xxh3), updated_at, and status:ready.

kind.description: WIDENED by REGISTER-ROUTE (2026-08-04) from const "ai". A consumer may now commit a proxy, poster or waveform it generated on-device, not only AI. `filmstrip` is deliberately NOT here: its reader contract (minimum canvas, zero-gutter cell origin, upright-as-displayed, undefined trailing cells) is unspecified, so an edge-written strip is not yet safely renderable by another client. REQUIRES the `contribute-derivatives` capability token — the historical `contribute` token means AI-only and an older provider advertises it identically, so feature-detect on the new one.

producer.description: Who computed it. on-device = Apple frameworks / BYO cloud key on a Mac.

hash.description: The server's canonical xxh3 of the source (== source_hash). On-device consumers verify with size/mtime, not this; an xxh3-capable client/web UI can verify by hash.

blob_rel_path.description: Volume-relative under /.juicemount/derivatives/<inode>/. The consumer wrote the bytes; the server only indexes the row. WIDENED from const "ai.loupe.json" for the coordinated loupe->logger cutover (2026-08-03): both names are ACCEPTED indefinitely. A provider advertising `wire_terms:"logger/1"` in /whoami WRITES `ai.logger.json`; it still reads and indexes either. Consumers may send either — prefer `ai.logger.json` once the provider advertises the flag.

media_type.description: WIDENED with REGISTER-ROUTE. ASSIGNED BY THE SERVER FROM `kind`, never echoed from the request — ai/waveform => application/json, proxy => video/mp4, poster => image/jpeg. This is deliberate: /blob pins its response Content-Type from this row field, so a contributor-supplied media_type would be a contributor-controlled Content-Type served from the control-plane origin.

model.description: Embedding model id+version so kNN partitions by space (e.g. apple-featureprint-v1 vs the portable openclip-vit-b32-v1).

source_size.description: The server's authoritative (re-stat'd) source size in bytes — echoes the vouched value on accept, so any client's read-gate can stat-verify off the manifest.

source_mtime.description: The server's authoritative (re-stat'd) source mtime (unix seconds).
